items.name: beacon
items.title: Beacon
items.description: Customer-support eve agent with docs search, approved replies, SLA watch, and Zendesk/Intercom/Slack reach. Inspect with Aletheia before you run it.

overview: Beacon is a customer-support eve agent blueprint from the Aletheia project. It searches docs, drafts replies behind an approval gate, routes hard tickets to humans, and watches SLA clocks.
Use Aletheia (https://github.com/danielalbinsson/Aletheia) to render a verified self-portrait and capability review before you run or deploy the agent.
howItWorks: Inbound support work arrives through your channel of choice; the agent searches docs with search_docs.
When confident, it calls draft_reply, which parks for human approval (always()).
Hard or sensitive questions go through route_ticket; sla_watch runs on a schedule to raise breaches early.

useCases.title: First-line support draft
useCases.body: Install into an eve app and wire Intercom/Zendesk/Slack credentials when you leave stub land.

useCases.title: Trust review training
useCases.body: Point Aletheia at the agent to teach teammates what reach and approval look like on a real support agent.

requirements.name: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
requirements.body: Or Vercel OIDC — model credential for the gateway id in agent/agent.ts.

requirements.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
requirements.body: Optional until you enable the Slack MCP connection.

requirements.name: INTERCOM_API_KEY
requirements.body: Optional until you enable the Intercom OpenAPI connection.

faqs.question: Are the tools production-ready?
faqs.answer: Bodies are stubs that return mock success. Replace execute implementations with your APIs; keep approval on draft_reply.

faqs.question: How do I inspect capabilities?
faqs.answer: Use Aletheia locally or npx @aletheia/cli diff after eve build.
